A '''depot station''' operated by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyne Albamon]]. The station was created some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Bordal Contagion]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
